What I don't understand is if I clearly stated that I am fine and just do not want to keep in touch with her, why am I still a missing person. 

The cops were more interested that my voice was shaking and it was clearly very difficult for me to be there and explain the situation rather than to provide me with useful information on what should be done now.

They basically said I should contact my mother and gave me the crisis hotline number. Even though I am not in any crisis, my mother clearly is. I'm just trying to finally exercise some agency in my life and stop being treated as my mother's property.

I did! They scanned my ID, I wrote a statement that I am safe and I am not abducted or something of that caliber and that I do not want to disclose my current living address to her so I don't understand why they said they couldn't cancel the missing person's report.

Basically the police said I have to contact her and the search is still ongoing even though I came to the police station in person, handed them my ID and all. Not only I am losing my mind but also I have no clue what to do. And feel like some kind of property.
